title: T1132.001 — Data Encoding - Standard Encoding
subtitle: Watch the animation, then read the story below it.

steps.title: Foothold check-in
steps.caption: The implant is already on the laptop. It sends its first check-in as a plain web request to a parked domain that looks like ordinary browsing.
steps.defender: one boring GET request - this is why saved logs and baselines matter.

steps.title: Steady polling
steps.caption: Every 60 seconds the laptop asks for tasks. The server replies empty until work is ready.
steps.defender: the fixed 60-second cadence is the first real clue. Humans do not click with timer precision.

steps.title: Encoded task arrives
steps.caption: The C2 server fills the answer with a short Base64 string in the s parameter.
steps.defender: standard Base64 length is always divisible by 4 - an easy test on the wire.

steps.title: Decode and execute
steps.caption: The implant decodes d2hvYW1p into whoami and runs the command on the laptop. No packets move - this step is local.
steps.defender: Sysmon shows cmd.exe starting under the implant process instead of the browser - a parent-child break.

steps.title: Encoded reply
steps.caption: The command output is Base64-encoded, hidden in a cookie header, and POSTed back to the same URL.
steps.defender: cookies that carry command output instead of a session ID are a strong red flag.

steps.title: SOC sees noise
steps.caption: The SOC watches the netflow. The proxy shows opaque strings, but no rule fires yet.
steps.defender: absence of alerts is not absence of attack. Keep the raw logs.

steps.title: Decode and correlate
steps.caption: The analyst decodes the parameter and reads whoami . Linked with the odd process lineage, a correlation alert fires.
steps.defender: standard encoding is reversible - decode it and it becomes evidence.

steps.title: Contain and hunt
steps.caption: The team blocks the C2 domain, isolates the laptop, and sweeps every proxy for the same URI pattern. Two more hosts match.
steps.defender: hunt the pattern, not the one host - one good pattern can find a whole campaign.
